background: Danske Bank is Denmark's largest bank, a Nordic universal bank funded by Danish and Nordic deposits and covered bonds, lending to households and companies across Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland, with the Estonian money-laundering case behind it.
synthesis: Ratings are AA- on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A+, with one on a positive outlook and two on a stable outlook, and the last move a two-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. Capital is mixed against EU and Nordic peers: CET1 of 17.0% is above the peer median, but leverage of 4.4% is in the bottom quarter. Liquidity is also mixed, with LCR of 162% above the peer median and NSFR of 122% a little under it. The trend is down, with CET1 fallen 1.6 points, leverage 0.4 points and LCR 18 points since 30 Jun 2025, while the flagged news is all good, with one of the three moving to a positive outlook on 26 Aug 2026 after an earlier guidance upgrade.
